title: Lipschitz Functions on Sparse Graphs II
summary: Korsky, Saffat and Aiylam introduced a growth constant $c(G)$ for integer-valued $h$-Lipschitz functions on a finite graph $G$ and proved that, for $G=G(n,d/n)$, \[ \frac{1}{2d}+O(d^{-2})\le \log c(G)\le \frac{4\log^2 d}{d}+O(d^{-1}) \] with high probability. We sharpen the random-graph part of their result; as $n\to\infty$ and then $d\to\infty$, we prove \[ \log c(G)=\frac{π^2}{6d}+o(d^{-1}) \] with high probability.
